name: MIA-Bench
description: MIA-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on their ability to strictly follow complex instructions. It consists of 400 image-prompt pairs designed to test instruction adherence and response accuracy in multimodal contexts.
reputation: A recent multimodal instruction-following benchmark that is still emerging in the literature and has not yet seen broad community standardization.
notes: Focuses on instruction fidelity in multimodal LLMs with layered instructions and supervised fine-tuning data.
